title: Fixed rules from before the release still price their parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Have on staging an inventory part with a fixed sell price set before the release (for example $48.00) and a cost above zero.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with 10% off in the matrix of the part's category, and a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Fixed Rules tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Add the fixed-price part to work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Fixed Rules tab lists the part's fixed rule with its price ($48.00).

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 3:

  • The line is priced at the fixed price, $48.00 = the fixed rule's $48.00.
  • Its Priced by column reads Fixed price.
